frontier.hypothesis: func_80060E38 is a member of a 29-function class defined by 'target contains a stride-8 reload-spill block', all blocked by the same measured fork property, and should be dispositioned as a class rather than ground one function at a time.
frontier.mechanism: Census (s2/spillscan2.txt): 29 stride-8 spill blocks tree-wide, all at 0 mod 8, all rule-carrying, none ever matched. s6 and s7 supply the complementary halves: our fork allocates 131 four-byte spill slots tree-wide and every one is at 4 mod 8, because the offset is congruent to -GET_MODE_SIZE(mode) (mod 8) under BYTES_BIG_ENDIAN with both free inputs proved to be multiples of 8 (1694/1694 measured), and the only uncorrected path never executes. cc1psx fed identical input produces target's congruence. Every surface that could change it (the cc1 binary/configuration, the Makefile, prologue_config.json, regfix/asmfix) is outside the grind edit surface, and no-compiler-divergence forbids the compiler-side fix.
frontier.next_probe: Still an owner-surface question and the driver has NOT declared exhaustion, so it must not be escalated yet. Whichever session is assigned escalation modality should file the CLASS in docs/grind/decisions.md citing s2/spillscan2.txt, the closed form, the cc1psx counter-exhibit, the s3 reuse-branch kill, the s4+s5 ~159.5k-mutation negative, s5's taxonomy closure, s6's tree-wide path census and s7's tree-wide input census - and must NOT cite Ruling-2, whose scope limit excludes non-crashing fork divergences.
